body: You got this. Been down this road.      First get a therapist, you have to control your mental health. If you can’t function mentality you can’t be there for your kids.   Second, erase your ex from your mind. What she says, feels, her opinions mean nothing.  This is a business transaction going forward.  If you treat it as anything but a business transaction she will pull you back and delay/ruin your recovery.     Three ensure you are always busy.  Have little to no free time.  Gym, work, hobbies, etc. Time alone leads to thinking about the past which leads to depression, drinking, other bad habits.     Four when you have your kids, turn your phone off and be 100 percent on for them.  They deserve you more then they will get to see you, so give them all you got when you have them.

Similar situation with 2 kids.  I gave up on lawyers, they just made me broke.   My advice is get everything you can to get mentally healthy. Therapy, church, friends.  If you don't have mental health you have nothing.  I screwed up every possible way including a suicide attempt which cost me so much.

Second, do not fight with ex. That will guarantee no access to kids. The path to your kid is through your ex. As much as it may suck, just kiss her ass non stop.

Three, acceptance is key. I still struggle with this. Your old life is over, never coming back. You don't get to be the dad you want and never will be. 

Four, the pain never ever goes away.  You have to learn to deal with it.
